# wherdr

> Self-hosted web app and phone PWA to follow and drive the coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, omp…) running in Herdr on your machines, over localhost or a private network only. Open source, MIT.

## Docs

- [Setup guide for agents](https://wherdr.dev/agent.md): what to detect before asking, the one install command, the phone over Tailscale, the passkey lock on the tailnet address, safety rules
- [Installer](https://wherdr.dev/install): `curl -fsSL https://wherdr.dev/install | sh`, the one install path on macOS and Linux: checks Herdr, installs the wherdr Herdr plugin (Node.js 22, or Docker on Linux), starts wherdr; headless servers get the address and phone steps. `WHERDR_MODE=docker` sets up Docker Compose by hand instead (Linux)
- [Herdr plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afloury/wherdr/main/herdr-plugin.toml): what the installer runs, `herdr plugin install afloury/wherdr` (Linux: Docker when available, else Node.js 22; macOS: Node.js 22)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afloury/wherdr/main/README.md): features, installation, configuration, troubleshooting
- [Other private networks](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr#other-private-networks): phone access over Headscale, NetBird, ZeroTier, WireGuard or Cloudflare Tunnel + Access instead of Tailscale (HTTPS with a valid certificate, `APP_URL`)
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afloury/wherdr/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr)
- [Herdr](https://herdr.dev): the terminal workspace for coding agents wherdr builds on
